node.title: Re^3: Return array from sub or return empty array (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [gregzartman],

The simple solution is to just do:

@array2 = a_sub_that_returns_a_list || '';

As [AnomalousMonk] [id://1167105|explained], I doubt that code will do something that is useful for you...?

Why not just do

@array2 = a_sub_that_returns_a_list();

?

Regards,
-- Hauke D
